name: git-compass
description: A friendly, visual Git cockpit: commit graph, guided commits, branches, stashes, history, blame, interactive rebase, conflict help, GitHub pull requests and a built-in Git guide.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Git Compass runs git commands in your workspace.

enumDescriptions: Ask whether to commit all changes when nothing is staged
Always commit all changes when nothing is staged
gitCompass.smartCommit.markdownDescription: What happens when you press **Commit** and no files are staged.

enumDescriptions: Merge remote commits into yours (safest, default)
Replay your commits on top of the remote ones (linear history)
Only fast-forward; stop if branches diverged
gitCompass.pullStrategy.description: How Pull/Sync combines remote commits with yours.

gitCompass.autoFetch.description: Fetch from remotes automatically every N minutes (0 = off) so the Overview can tell you when new commits are available.

gitCompass.viewAsTree.description: Show changed files as a folder tree instead of a flat list.

gitCompass.switchToNewBranch.description: Switch to a branch right after creating it.

gitCompass.followActiveEditor.description: With several repositories open, automatically switch to the repository of the file you are editing.

gitCompass.scanNestedRepositories.description: Also look for repositories one folder level below each workspace folder.

gitCompass.blame.currentLine.description: Show who last changed the current line (faint text at the end of the line).

gitCompass.blame.hover.description: Show commit details when hovering the blame annotation.

gitCompass.blame.maxLines.description: Skip blame for files longer than this.

gitCompass.graph.pageSize.description: Number of commits loaded at once in the Commit Graph editor tab.

gitCompass.graph.sidebarPageSize.description: Number of commits loaded at once in the sidebar Graph view.

gitCompass.fileHistory.maxCount.description: Maximum number of commits shown in File History.

gitCompass.statusBar.description: Show branch / push / pull status in the status bar.

gitCompass.useVSCodeGitForNetwork.description: Use VS Code's built-in Git for push/pull/fetch so GitHub sign-in and credential prompts work automatically. Turn off to always use the git command line.

gitCompass.gitPath.description: Path to the git executable. Leave empty to auto-detect.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Git Compass
walkthroughs.description: Learn Git step by step with your new Git cockpit.

steps.title: Meet Git Compass
steps.description:
Everything lives behind the compass icon in the activity bar.
[Open Git Compass](command:gitCompass.overview.focus)

steps.title: Tell Git who you are
steps.description:
Every commit records an author. Set your name and email once per computer.
[Set Name & Email](command:gitCompass.setIdentity)

steps.title: Get a repository
steps.description:
Turn the current folder into a repository, or download one.
[Initialize Repository](command:gitCompass.init)
[Clone Repository](command:gitCompass.clone)

steps.title: Make a commit
steps.description:
Review your changes, write a message, press Commit.
[Go to Commit box](command:gitCompass.overview.focus)

steps.title: Back it up on GitHub
steps.description:
Sign in and publish your repository (private or public).
[Publish to GitHub](command:gitCompass.publishToGitHub)

steps.title: Try a branch
steps.description:
Work on a feature without touching main, then merge it.
[Create a Branch](command:gitCompass.createBranch)

steps.title: See the big picture
steps.description:
The Commit Graph shows every branch and commit.
[Open Commit Graph](command:gitCompass.openGraph)

steps.title: Keep the guide handy
steps.description:
Undo cheat-sheet, conflicts, glossary and more.
[Open Guide](command:gitCompass.openGuide)
